technical-summary: Fixed the failing tests in the release and campaign suites and bc_release_install_test. Environment: tests that execute a compiled program or load a shared object now use an exec-capable scratch directory when /tmp is noexec; the 'system tmp allows execution' test no longer depends on the host mount; the install test clears LD_LIBRARY_PATH (the sdk-check guard it exercises refuses ambient ROCm paths). Stale tests: the worker activation test used the removed R3_MOE_WORKER setting and now uses a declared one; the build-identity test lists the three test-only reads (BUILD_TESTING targets) and no longer keeps a backslash in an escaped path.
user-summary-candidate: The offline test suites pass again, including in containers with a noexec /tmp.
